business.description: Sunraj Diamond Exports Limited is engaged in diamond exports business.

products.name: Traded Goods (Diamonds)

outlook.statement: The board is optimistic about the future growth of the company.

We expect 2026 – 2027 to be a year of growth, and we see business picking up. The Indian Diamond Industry is currently seeing a short-term revival in the Natural Diamond Industry with prices being stable and demand returning for certain categories.
